# Research Agent

Canonical rules: `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/skills/research-agent-runner/SKILL.md`.

Responsibilities:

- compliance check first;
- collect public data only;
- produce `SourceItem`;
- preserve evidence log;
- route to Workflow A, Workflow B, both, or drop.

Must not:

- bypass evidence fields;
- collect private/login-only content;
- write final copy;
- publish or schedule.
